name: demo-stall
description: Demo "Stalled": a migration that declares its plan, writes the partition migration, then goes completely silent (no output, no transcript writes, no tool calls) for 3 hours while its process stays alive; AOC shows it Stalled once the stall threshold (10 minutes by default) passes. Nudge or Restart resumes it after the silence and it finishes.

args.summary: Move interaction history to a monthly-partitioned table without downtime.

tasks.title: Switch reads to the partitioned table

steps.text: Starting the backfill dry-run against the staging snapshot; this can take a while.

steps.note: Silent for 3 hours: AOC must show Stalled, not Thinking.

steps.text: The dry-run came back; continuing with the backfill script.
Migration complete: partitioned table, backfill, dual-write and the read switch.
